== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Hanging [[Trees]] are powerful entities used to maintain order and prevent total anarchy. Originally planted by ancestors, ten such trees exist, with each one guarded by an Overlord. These trees function by sealing [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] [[Incarnations]] beneath them, a process that requires [[blood]] sacrifices. For those being sealed, particularly [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] [[Incarnations]], the experience is described as an agonizing state of semi-consciousness that lasts for centuries. The trees must remain in contact with the earth and are capable of growing rapidly. While they serve as a defense against chaos, they can be weakened by starvation, which causes them to feed on themselves. When a tree dies, its remains may transform into other objects, such as wicker [[furniture]]. Additionally, seeds from these trees exist, which possess a potent and pulsing power that can be used as a weapon.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The Hanging [[Tree]] is a [[blood]]-red [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] sapling with crimson leaves that writhes with [[hunger]] and must remain in contact with the earth. Originally planted by the ancestors of [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]], these trees have been handed down for generations, with the King himself planting a tenth specimen. While [[Alin]]'s mission was intended to destroy this target, [[Grandmaster Naraka]] attempted to summon power to incinerate it in a failed effort to sabotage the force. These trees are used for sacrifices, and their [[destruction]] poses a significant threat as losing them allows [[Incarnations]] to escape. Following various strikes by teams in [[Cana]], [[Tamara]] carries a seed toward the Hanging [[Tree]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Originally located in the dungeon beneath the palace, the remnants of [[Cana]]'s Hanging [[Tree]] were eventually discovered at the bottom of a floor hole. These trees serve as a system for sealing [[Incarnations]], though they were never intended to function against [[Queen]] [[Cynara]]'s kind. While an ancient [[Incarnation]] remained trapped beneath the tree for over three centuries, the process of sealing requires a cost of [[blood]] and has the ability to drain a person's power. Ultimately, these entities failed [[Simon]] and possess the capability to swarm and devour targets using their crimson branches.}}
